story.titleZh: F1车手展望首次驶上“疯狂”的马德里赛道赛道
story.summaryZh: F1车手准备周五首次驾驶“吓人”且“疯狂”的马德里赛道赛道，预计它将成为本赛季“最复杂”的赛道。
story.originalTitle: F1's 'most complicated' track - What drivers expect from the Madring
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers are bracing to drive the "scary" and "crazy" Madring circuit for the first time on Friday, with expectations that it will be the "most complicated" track of the year.
detailZh: F1车手们正准备在周五首次驾驶“吓人”且“疯狂”的马德里赛道赛道，预计它将成为本赛季“最复杂”的赛道。
所有F1车手都已经在虚拟世界中完成了许多圈，为三年来第一条全新赛道做准备，但周四让他们近距离看到了赛道在现实世界中的样子。
以下是车手们的期望，从最艰难的弯道到是否错失了改善超车的机会。
两周前在该赛道进行的为期两天的F3测试产生了19次红旗，提高了人们对疯狂周末的期望，威廉姆斯车队负责人James Vowles称其为“杀死赛车的赛道”。
“当我听说F3中有20[19]次红旗时，我有点惊讶。然后在我驾驶模拟器后，我惊讶于只有20[19]次红旗，”梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔打趣道。
“这是一条疯狂的赛道。我会说，它可以说是整个赛历中最危险的赛道。”
赛道上布满了棘手的弯道、盲区出口和靠近的墙壁，几乎没有犯错的空间。博托莱托将马德里赛道的一圈描述为“精神上令人疲惫”。
刚走完赛道的阿尔本表示，“很多墙壁，很多高速弯道，很多盲弯给我一种澳门的氛围，但更像是为F1赛道准备的”。
“有些弯道的盲区有点令人担忧，比如如果有一辆车停在弯道的另一侧，我希望他们在VSC[虚拟安全车]和红旗方面能迅速行动，”他补充道。
“不可避免的是，这个周末会有一些撞车事故。”
加斯利对此表示赞同，他说：“我肯定会把赌注押在红旗上”，他预计会有相当“混乱的周末”和事故。
Albon表示，他“相当担心”在倾斜的La Monumental弯道排位赛中赛车将如何让路，考虑到你通过那里的线路和盲区出口。
“我认为没有正确的位置可以放置赛车，”Albon在谈到La Monumental时说。“如果你把车放在顶部，实际上我认为线路会漂移到赛道中间，然后你再回来。
“所以，你不在一个完美的地方。这让我有点想起，你还记得Fernando和Esteban在巴西3号弯的那次撞车吗[2023年冲刺排位赛]？
“你会遇到脏空气，脏空气会产生连锁反应。”
在模拟器运行后，凯迪拉克车手Sergio Perez表示，这是“一条真正的赛道。有点吓人。让我有点想起吉达”。队友Valtteri Bottas将其描述为吉达和巴库的混合体，而其他人则将其比作摩纳哥。
哈斯车手奥康称其为“疯狂的赛道”，需要在风险与回报之间做出许多权衡，而冠军领跑者安东内利表示，这对车手和工程师来说都是今年“最复杂”的赛道。
“从驾驶方面来说，你有各种各样的弯道。你有减速弯、快速弯、倾斜弯、中速弯，还有刹车——你有很多直线刹车，但也有[很多]刹车时你实际上仍在转弯，”Antonelli说。
“17号弯是一个当你踩刹车时，你仍在转弯，然后你拉直赛车的弯道。所以这是一条非常棘手的赛道，非常具有挑战性，但同时非常令人兴奋，零犯错空间。
“在工程方面也很复杂，因为找到一个对整个单圈都是良好妥协的调校并不容易。
“你可以找到一个在减速弯中帮助你、当你需要切路肩时的调校，或者一个在快速弯中帮助你的调校，但要找到一个在路肩上好、在改变方向时好、在快速弯中好的调校，将会很困难。”
人们预计周六的排位赛将非常激烈，但车手们对周日的比赛质量表示了新的担忧。
“超车会很困难。在我看来，会更接近新加坡，”Perez的观点。
不过，Gasly将其视为一个机会。他期待探索超车机会，因为车手们将不得不“在比赛日即兴发挥和创造，看看什么是可能的。
“我们将是这些首次动作的创造者。”
曾希望车手们采取不同线路进入La Monumental弯道会创造超车机会，但Albon并不那么确定。
“我担心比赛中的轮胎碎屑。所以除了试图找到干净空气并试图在倾斜弯道上走高线外，你还要在比赛后期应对轮胎碎屑，所以你必须小心，”Albon说。
“我个人认为你不能走那么多线路。赛道相当狭窄，当你拥有干净空气和空间时情况不同，而如果你有一点打滑，你就会立即撞墙。
“车手们不太愿意把车开到倾斜弯道的顶部并承担走高速线的风险。我希望我被证明是错的，但我认为赛道的那个部分不会提供那么多超车机会。”
哈斯车手Ollie Bearman觉得马德里赛道的布局错失了一个机会。
“在某种程度上这是一种遗憾，因为我认为布局还可以，但赛道有一些特性自然阻碍了超车，”Bearman说。
“其中之一是5号弯的刹车，它是弯曲的——而那是真正的超车机会。那种弯曲刹车消除了任何不同线路和从内侧发送的可能性。
“所以这是一种遗憾，也许有点疏忽，但这意味着我们将完全专注于排位赛。”
5/6号减速弯是F3测试中许多事故的发生地，前面有两个全油门弯道，这也是赛道上仅有的两个直线模式区域之一。
所以进入那个减速弯，以及第一个减速弯，是最合乎逻辑的超车机会。
但是，正如Bearman所说，进入减速弯的入口是弯曲且狭窄的，所以超车真的必须在刹车区之前完成。
Albon也有同样的挫败感，他认为周日的任何超车都将由能量管理差异决定，而不是刹车差异。
“我希望他们在刹车区做了一些不同的东西，不要让它们太倾斜，”Albon说。
“你有很多组合弯道，仅仅考虑周日的超车，感觉很容易防守。你只需把车放在赛道中间，就不会有车能超过你。
“这只是意味着这将是更多的部署超车而不是刹车超车。”
detailEn: Formula 1 drivers are bracing to drive the "scary" and "crazy" Madring circuit for the first time on Friday, with expectations that it will be the "most complicated" track of the year.

All F1 drivers have completed many laps in the virtual world to prepare for the first brand-new track in three years, but Thursday gave them their up-close look at how the circuit has come together in the real-world.
Here’s what the drivers are expecting, from the toughest corners to whether there was a missed opportunity to improve overtaking.

A two-day Formula 3 test at the circuit produced 19 red flags two weeks ago, raising expectations of a frenetic weekend, with Williams team principal James Vowles calling it "a track that kills cars".
"When I heard about the 20 [19] red flags in F3, I was a bit surprised. And then after I drove on the sim, I was surprised there was only 20 [19] red flags," quipped Mercedes driver George Russell.
"It's a crazy circuit. I would put it, arguably, as the most risky circuit of the whole calendar."
The circuit is littered with tricky corners, blind exits and close walls that leave very little room for error. "Mentally exhausting" is how Gabriel Bortoleto described a lap of the Madring.
Fresh from walking the track, Alex Albon said there's "a lot of walls, a lot of high-speed corners, a lot of blind corners gives me vibes of Macau, but more for an F1 track".

"A little bit concerning the blind spots in some of the corners, like if there is a car that's stopped on the other side of the corner, I hope they're just quick on the VSCs [virtual safety cars] and the red flags," he added.
"Inevitably, there are going to be a few crashes this weekend."
Pierre Gasly echoed that, saying, "I'll put my money on the red flag, that's for sure", and he expects quite a "disrupted weekend" with accidents.
Albon said he is "quite concerned" about where cars will get out of the way in qualifying at the banked La Monumental corner, given the line you take through there and the blind exit.

"I don't think there's a correct place you can position the car," Albon said of La Monumental. “If you put the car up top, actually I think the line is kind of drift up to the middle of the track and then you come back again.
"So, you're not in a perfect place. It reminds me a little bit of, do you remember Fernando and Esteban in Brazil at Turn 3, where they had that crash [in sprint qualifying in 2023]?
"You can get dirty air and the dirty air can create the knock-on effect."

After his simulator running, Cadillac driver Sergio Perez said it was "a proper track. It's a bit scary. It reminds me a bit of Jeddah". Team-mate Valtteri Bottas described it as a mix between Jeddah and Baku, while others have compared it to Monaco.

Haas driver Esteban Ocon called it a "crazy circuit" with so much risk versus reward trade-offs to make, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli said it's the "most complicated" track of the year for both drivers and engineers.

"Driving-wise, you've got all kinds of corners. You've got chicanes, fast corners, banked, medium-speed, also braking - you've got a lot of straight-line braking, but [also] a lot of braking where you're actually still turning," Antonelli said.

"Turn 17 is a corner where, when you hit the brake, you're still turning, and then you straighten the car. So it's a very tricky track, very challenging, but very exciting at the same time with zero margin of mistake.
"It's also complicated on the engineering side because finding a set-up that is a good compromise for the whole lap is not going to be easy.

"You can find a set-up that helps you in the chicanes, when you need to cut kerbs, or a set-up that helps you in the fast corners, but to find a set-up that is good over kerbs, good on changing direction, good on fast corners, is going to be difficult."
There are expectations for a knife-edge qualifying on Saturday, but drivers have expressed fresh concerns about the quality of racing on Sunday.
"Overtaking will be hard. It's going to be, in my mind, closer to Singapore," was Perez's view.
Gasly saw it as an opportunity, though. He was relishing exploring the overtaking opportunities, as drivers will have to "improvise and be creative on race day and see what's possible.
"We'll be the creators of these first moves."
There had been hopes that drivers taking different lines into the La Monumental corner would create an overtaking opportunity, but Albon isn’t so sure.

"I worry about the marbles in the race. So on top of trying to find clean air and trying to go up high on the banking, you'll have marbles to contend with as well later into the race, so you've got to be careful with that," Albon said.

"I personally don't think you can do that many lines. The track's quite narrow and it's different when you have clean air and there's space, whereas if you have a little snap you're into the wall immediately.

"Drivers aren't as willing to stick it up to the top of the banking and take the risk of running a high line. I hope I'm proved wrong, but I think that part of the track is not going to offer that much overtaking."
Haas driver Ollie Bearman felt like an opportunity was missed with the layout of the Madring.
"It's a shame in a way because I think the layout is OK, but there are some features of the circuit which naturally deter overtaking," Bearman said.

"One of them is the braking for Turn 5, which is curved - and that's the real overtaking opportunity. That kind of curved braking takes away any possibility of different lines and sending one up the inside.
"So that's a shame and maybe a bit of an oversight, but it means that we're going to be fully focused on qualifying."
The Turn 5/6 chicane, the site of many accidents in the F3 test, is preceded by two flat-out kinks, which also feature one of only two straight mode zones on the circuit.
So into that chicane, along with the first chicane, is the most logical overtaking opportunity.
But, as Bearman said, the entry to the chicane is curved and tight, so the overtakes will really have to be completed before the braking zone.
Albon shares his frustration, believing any overtakes on Sunday will be decided by energy management differences rather than braking differences.
"I wish they did something a bit different with the braking zones and not having them too much angled," Albon said.

"You've got a lot of combined corners which, just thinking of overtaking on Sunday, it feels like it's quite easy to defend. You just put the car in the middle of the track and you're not going to get a car that's going to go past you.
"That just means that it will be more of a deployment overtake than a braking overtake."
keyPointsZh: F3测试中出现了19次红旗，威廉姆斯车队负责人James Vowles称其为“杀死赛车的赛道”。
车手们对La Monumental弯道的超车机会表示担忧，阿尔本认为可能不会有太多超车。
哈斯车手Ollie Bearman认为赛道布局错失了超车机会，尤其是5号弯的弯曲刹车区。
keyPointsEn: The F3 test produced 19 red flags, with Williams team principal James Vowles calling it "a track that kills cars".
Drivers expressed concerns about overtaking opportunities at the La Monumental corner, with Alex Albon suggesting there may not be much overtaking.
Haas driver Ollie Bearman felt the track layout missed an opportunity for overtaking, especially with the curved braking zone at Turn 5.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
